Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.reporting.analyst

Class AnalystReportController

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.reporting.analyst.AnalystReportController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/reporting/analyst") public class AnalystReportController extends Object
Serves commercial analysts' long-range reports. Each covers the last twelve complete UTC months and takes no parameters; the response names the months it covers. Analysts only: see ReportingSecurityConfig.
